name: methodic
description: methodic: interviews a business, writes a traceable manual of its processes and intervenes on the operator's computer only with backup and OK. Industrial engineering methods (procurement, cost and pricing, economic and financial evaluation) are its tools; every number comes from a script with a test. The company's data lives outside the plugin. Guides in English and Spanish.

python.title: Python command
python.description: What launches the MCP server: python (Windows with Python on the PATH), py (Windows launcher), python3 (macOS and Linux) or the absolute path to the executable. Python 3.11 or newer, with openpyxl.

data.title: Data folder (optional)
data.description: Absolute path to the data folder methodic-data (the one with profiles/ and cases/). Empty: the server uses METHODIC_DATA (or the legacy INGENIERO_DATOS), then the sibling folder ../methodic-data (or the legacy ../ingeniero-agentico-datos), else the temp folder.

roots.title: Extra folders the server can read and write (optional)
roots.description: Absolute paths separated by ; on Windows or : on macOS and Linux (the folders of a task you want to map). Empty: only the repo, the data folder and the work folder.
